name: AutoFix
description: Automatically sanitizes messy release titles, resolves missing TMDb metadata, injects posters, and cleans movie and TV episode filenames in-place.
overview: Permanently eliminates blank grey boxes in Jellyfin by resolving TMDb IDs, injecting artwork, and cleanly in-place renaming movies, TV series episodes, and subtitles directly from confirmed Jellyfin metadata.
